head.lead: Every token is a short-lived API key. The value is shown once when minted; afterwards only the accessor remains. Revoking a token also revokes all of its children.

bulk.hint: They will be revoked together with their child tokens

foot.live: TTL ticks in real time · expired tokens disappear on their own
foot.enrichCap: Details loaded for the first {{n}} tokens

empty.title: No tokens
empty.text: There are no active tokens in this namespace. Mint the first one: the value is shown once and only the accessor stays in the list.
empty.noMatch: Nothing found. Change the query or

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.text: Your token's policies do not allow list on auth/token/. Ask an administrator to add the capability or use a token with the admin policy.

error.title: Could not load tokens
error.text: The server is unreachable or returned an error. Check the connection and try again.

confirm.text: The token and its child tokens will be revoked immediately. This cannot be undone.
confirm.label: Revoke

prefix.title: Revoke by prefix
prefix.text: Dangerous operation: every token whose name starts with the prefix is revoked at once.
prefix.label: Revoke all ({{count}})

toast.revokedText: {{name}} and its children are no longer valid
toast.revokedManyText: Child tokens were revoked with them
toast.hiddenText: It is stored nowhere. If you lost the token, mint a new one.
toast.copiedText: Paste it into a password manager or a CI environment variable

reveal.title: Token minted. Copy it now.
reveal.warn: ◆ The value will not be shown again

create.title: Create token
create.desc: A token authenticates API requests. Attach policies: they define access.
create.name: Display name
create.policiesNone: No policies selected: the token will have access to nothing.
create.policiesTextHint: The policy list is unavailable: type the names by hand.
create.ttlErr: TTL cannot be shorter than a minute.
create.usesErr: Enter a whole number, 0 or more.
create.nsHint: The token is bound to the namespace of the current session.

self.title: My token
self.subtitle: The token of the current console session.
self.hint: renew-self extends the token by its original TTL, but not past max_ttl.
self.renewedText: The token is valid for {{total}} more
self.loadFailed: Could not load the token details

roles.copyNow: Copy the token now — it will not be shown again.
roles.delWarn: Tokens already minted keep working until they expire. No new tokens can be minted from the role.

e.durFormat: Format: a number and a unit — 30s, 15m, 1h, 7d.
e.nameFormat: Lowercase Latin letters, digits, hyphen and "_" only: payments-api.
e.nameTaken: Role "{{n}}" already exists. Pick another name or open it for editing.
e.policiesEmpty: Add at least one policy, otherwise the token only gets default.
e.ttlOverMax: TTL ({{a}}) exceeds the explicit maximum ({{b}}). Lower the TTL or raise the maximum.
e.uses: A whole number from 0. Empty or 0 means unlimited.

roles.emptyText: A role is a token mint template: policies, lifetime and limits. Create the first one — services get tokens without the right to change their own properties.
roles.errText: The server did not respond. Check that the vault is unsealed and try again.
roles.forbiddenText: Your token lacks the list capability on auth/token/roles/. Ask an administrator to add a policy for this path.
roles.lead1: Mint template: a role fixes policies, lifetime and limits,
roles.lead2: A service asks not for an "all-powerful token" but for a token by role.
roles.leadB: and the token receives them without the right to change them
roles.name: Role name
roles.nameHelp: Lowercase Latin letters, digits, hyphen. The name cannot be changed after creation.
roles.noMatchText: No roles match the query and the selected filter.
roles.perWarn: A period is set: TTL is ignored on renewal and the explicit maximum caps the total token lifetime.
roles.periodHelp: A periodic token renews indefinitely as long as it is renewed in time.
roles.polHelp: A token minted from this role gets these policies plus default.
roles.renewHelp: The token holder may renew it up to the explicit maximum.
roles.sumArmed: Unsaved changes will be lost — press again to close
roles.title: Token roles
